svg.title: Compact management cluster: installation, platform layers and tenant handoff
svg.desc: The reference composition separates UCS vNIC provisioning from OpenShift installation and Day 2 host networking. Argo CD reconciles management Applications through the local Kubernetes API. HyperShift and KubeVirt create hosted control-plane pods and worker VMs, while guest Applications use a separately registered tenant Kubernetes API.
svg.text: Compact management cluster: installation, platform layers and tenant handoff
UCS creates vNICs; AgentConfig creates bond0; GitOps and NMState create bond1 and hosted-cluster state after installation.

g.text: Physical composition: fabric and server interfaces
guest apps use a named target
registered in Argo CD as selected tenant
